title: Module 08 – File Handling and Data Processing

concepts.name: File Paths, open(), Context Managers (with) & File Exceptions

criteria.statement: Uses 'with open(..., encoding="utf-8")' so file descriptors close automatically even on error.
Handles FileNotFoundError and PermissionError gracefully using pathlib.Path and try/except.
Reads and writes CSV files with csv.DictReader/DictWriter (using newline='').
Serializes and deserializes Python dicts/lists with json.load/json.dump and handles JSONDecodeError.

concepts.name: Extension: Iterators, Generators & yield for Stream Processing

criteria.statement: Contrasts yield (suspends frame, O(1) memory) with return (terminates frame, eager list).
Writes a lazy generator pipeline to filter/transform large streams without loading everything into RAM.
